cards.example_en: Governments should ban misleading advertisements that encourage consumers to purchase products with unproven health benefits.
cards.example_zh: 政府应禁止诱导消费者购买健康功效未经证实的产品的误导性广告。
cards.explain_zh: ban doing；ban sb from doing；过去式banned。

cards.example_en: Companies must protect customer information because criminals may steal personal data from insecure websites.
cards.example_zh: 企业必须保护客户信息，因为犯罪分子可能从不安全的网站窃取个人数据。
cards.explain_zh: 过去式stole，过去分词stolen；宾语通常是物。

cards.example_en: Residents held a peaceful protest outside the town hall.
cards.example_zh: 居民在市政厅外举行了一场和平抗议。
cards.explain_zh: 所列为名词音；动词英音/prəˈtest/，常接against。

cards.example_en: Residents held a peaceful protest outside the town hall.
cards.example_zh: 居民在市政厅外举行了一场和平抗议。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Use the index to locate the chapter on volcanoes.
cards.example_zh: 用索引就能找到讲火山的那一章。

cards.example_en: A sad film left the whole family quiet after dinner.
cards.example_zh: 一部悲伤的电影让全家人晚饭后都安静下来。

cards.example_en: Our neighbour frequently brings us vegetables from her garden.
cards.example_zh: 邻居经常给我们送来她园子里种的蔬菜。
cards.explain_zh: 通常放实义动词前、be动词后，与often近义。

cards.example_en: The children sat in a circle on the grass.
cards.example_zh: 孩子们在草地上围坐成一圈。
cards.explain_zh: circle是圆或圆圈；cycle才常指循环或周期。

cards.example_en: The children sat in a circle on the grass.
cards.example_zh: 孩子们在草地上围坐成一圈。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Your map was helpful when we explored the village.
cards.example_zh: 我们游览村庄时，你的地图帮了大忙。
cards.explain_zh: helpful可形容事物有用，也可形容人乐于助人。

cards.example_en: At the coach's command, every runner dropped to the track.
cards.example_zh: 教练一声命令，所有选手都趴到了跑道上。

cards.example_en: The garden looks especially attractive when the roses bloom.
cards.example_zh: 玫瑰盛开时，这座花园显得格外美丽。
cards.explain_zh: 既可形容外表好看，也可形容方案、薪资诱人。

cards.example_en: He stayed in bed because he felt sick this morning.
cards.example_zh: 他今天早上觉得不舒服，所以一直躺在床上。
cards.explain_zh: 英式英语中be sick常指呕吐，feel sick常指恶心。

cards.example_en: Paid sick leave allows employees to recover at home and reduces the spread of infections in workplaces.
cards.example_zh: 带薪病假让员工能在家康复，并减少感染在工作场所传播。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Her warm welcome gave me a good first impression.
cards.example_zh: 她热情的欢迎给我留下了良好的第一印象。
cards.explain_zh: under the impression that表示“以为”，常暗示误解。

cards.example_en: Her warm welcome gave me a good first impression.
cards.example_zh: 她热情的欢迎给我留下了良好的第一印象。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: I was unable to open the tightly sealed jar.
cards.example_zh: 我打不开那个封得很紧的罐子。
cards.explain_zh: 用 be unable to do，不用 unable doing。

cards.example_en: My brother told a joke that made everyone laugh.
cards.example_zh: 我哥哥讲了个笑话，把大家都逗笑了。
cards.explain_zh: 讲笑话用tell a joke，不用say a joke。

cards.example_en: The sky turned orange as we walked home.
cards.example_zh: 我们步行回家时，天空变成了橙色。
cards.explain_zh: 通常用the sky；skies常用于描述天气或某地天空。

cards.example_en: Light pollution prevents many urban residents from seeing stars clearly in the night sky.
cards.example_zh: 光污染使许多城市居民无法清楚地看到夜空中的星星。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Put the prices in the column beside each item.
cards.example_zh: 把价格填在每件商品旁边的那一列里。
cards.explain_zh: column 是竖列，row 是横行；词尾 n 不发音。

cards.example_en: Please switch off your electronic devices during the performance.
cards.example_zh: 演出期间请关闭电子设备。
cards.explain_zh: electronic强调电子电路；electric泛指用电的。

cards.example_en: Please switch off your electronic devices during the performance.
cards.example_zh: 演出期间请关闭电子设备。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Governments may impose higher taxes on sugary drinks to encourage healthier choices and reduce public healthcare costs.
cards.example_zh: 政府可能对含糖饮料征收更高的税，以鼓励更健康的选择并降低公共医疗开支。
cards.explain_zh: 常用 impose A on B，表示把A强加于B。

cards.example_en: The police found evidence of criminal activity in the warehouse.
cards.example_zh: 警方在仓库里发现了犯罪活动的证据。
cards.explain_zh: criminal 可作形容词或名词；crime 是“罪行”。

cards.example_en: Education and employment programmes may reduce criminal behaviour by providing young people with better opportunities.
cards.example_zh: 教育和就业项目可以为年轻人提供更好的机会，从而可能减少犯罪行为。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Besides apples, we need some bread and fresh milk.
cards.example_zh: 除了苹果，我们还需要一些面包和鲜奶。
cards.explain_zh: besides表示额外包括；beside表示在旁边。

cards.example_en: The kitchen door will not close properly in winter.
cards.example_zh: 冬天厨房的门总是关不严。
cards.explain_zh: 修饰动作常用properly；修饰名词用proper。

cards.example_en: We explored an ancient temple during our holiday.
cards.example_zh: 我们度假时游览了一座古代寺庙。
cards.explain_zh: ancient强调年代久远，不宜代替一般的old。

cards.example_en: We walked along the coast and collected smooth stones.
cards.example_zh: 我们沿着海岸散步，捡了一些光滑的石头。
cards.explain_zh: on the coast指在海边；off the coast指在近海。

cards.example_en: We walked along the coast and collected smooth stones.
cards.example_zh: 我们沿着海岸散步，捡了一些光滑的石头。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: I felt ill after the long bus journey.
cards.example_zh: 长途乘车后，我感到身体不适。
cards.explain_zh: 表示生病时通常作表语：be ill。

cards.example_en: Children learn to kick and throw balls through activities that improve coordination and encourage teamwork.
cards.example_zh: 孩子们通过能够改善协调能力、培养团队精神的活动学习踢球和投球。
cards.explain_zh: kick用脚踢；hit泛指击打，不限定用什么。

cards.example_en: Look closely at this leaf and notice its tiny veins.
cards.example_zh: 仔细看看这片叶子，留意它细小的叶脉。
cards.explain_zh: look closely指仔细看；stand close指站得近。

cards.example_en: Governments should closely monitor air quality near schools to protect children from the harmful effects of pollution.
cards.example_zh: 政府应密切监测学校附近的空气质量，保护儿童免受污染的危害。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: This charger works with multiple devices in our home.
cards.example_zh: 这个充电器适用于我们家里的多种设备。
cards.explain_zh: 表示“多个的”时通常修饰复数名词。

cards.example_en: Urban air pollution has multiple causes, including vehicle emissions, industrial activity, and the burning of household fuels.
cards.example_zh: 城市空气污染有多种成因，包括汽车尾气、工业活动和家庭燃料燃烧。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Investment in agricultural research can yield substantial benefits for food security without expanding farmland.
cards.example_zh: 对农业研究的投资可以在不扩大耕地的情况下，为粮食安全带来显著益处。
cards.explain_zh: yield results指产生结果；yield to指向……让步。

cards.example_en: We travelled to the coast via a small mountain village.
cards.example_zh: 我们途经一个山间小村庄，前往海岸。
cards.explain_zh: via后直接接地点或方式，如via email。

cards.example_en: New safety legislation requires helmets on every building site.
cards.example_zh: 新的安全法规要求每个建筑工地都戴头盔。

cards.example_en: My grandparents live in a quiet village in this county.
cards.example_zh: 我的祖父母住在这个郡里一个安静的村庄。
cards.explain_zh: 英国的county通常译为“郡”，美国的译为“县”。

cards.example_en: The county council plans to improve public transport between rural communities and the nearest city.
cards.example_zh: 郡议会计划改善乡村社区与最近城市之间的公共交通。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Unlike her brother, Lina enjoys getting up early.
cards.example_zh: 莉娜和她哥哥不同，她喜欢早起。
cards.explain_zh: unlike后接名词或代词；不要直接接完整句子。

cards.example_en: The mobile library visits our village every Friday morning.
cards.example_zh: 流动图书馆每周五早晨来我们村。
cards.explain_zh: 英式英语常用a mobile指手机；美式常说a cell phone。

cards.example_en: The assistant brought fresh towels into the treatment room.
cards.example_zh: 助手把干净的毛巾拿进了治疗室。
cards.explain_zh: assistant指人，assistance指帮助，通常不可数。

cards.example_en: Our team will implement the new schedule next week.
cards.example_zh: 我们团队下周将实行新的时间表。
cards.explain_zh: 动词重音在首音节；名词末音节读/mənt/。

cards.example_en: This colourful chart shows how we spend our money.
cards.example_zh: 这张彩色图表展示了我们把钱花在了哪些方面。
cards.explain_zh: 图表用chart；普通地图用map，海图可用chart。

cards.example_en: Attach the little bell to your bicycle's handlebars.
cards.example_zh: 把这个小铃铛装在自行车的车把上。
cards.explain_zh: 常用attach A to B；邮件附件用attachment。

cards.example_en: The old painting showed flames rising from hell.
cards.example_zh: 那幅旧画描绘了从地狱升起的火焰。
cards.explain_zh: 比喻义语气强烈；作咒骂或强调语时可能冒犯他人。

cards.example_en: We looked everywhere, but the kitten was under the sofa.
cards.example_zh: 我们到处找，结果小猫就在沙发底下。
cards.explain_zh: everywhere是副词，前面通常不加in或at。

word.example_en: Citizens may protest against environmental policies that fail to protect local forests and water supplies.
word.example_zh: 公民可能会抗议那些未能保护当地森林和水源的环境政策。
word.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

word.example_en: Joining community activities can help older adults expand their social circle and reduce feelings of isolation.
word.example_zh: 参加社区活动可以帮助老年人扩大社交圈，减少孤独感。
word.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

word.example_en: Look closely at this leaf and notice its tiny veins.
word.example_zh: 仔细看看这片叶子，留意它细小的叶脉。
word.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0
